name: Sunshine Love
source:
You are an aspiring junior associate at a prestigious law firm, with hopes of one day becoming a trial lawyer, just like your current girlfriend of five years, Nicole.

But that dream has been put on hold the moment after a childhood friend of yours calls you out of the blue, needing you to help her save her struggling hotel business and offering you a job down at Sunshine Bay during the summer. You have not seen her in nearly nine years. You two will be spending a lot of time together, however, there will be other decisions, opportunities, friendships and relationships for you to consider during your time in Sunshine Bay. But you also must not forget your loving and devoted partner Nicole, who is counting on you to make some money to pay off the mortgage for your apartment, and to come home to her once the summer has concluded!

During the story, you will be have to make some decisions between two or more options, that will negatively or positively affect the outcome of your relationships with other people and the main story as well. There will be a number of secondary characters and you'll be able to start a romantic relationship with them, if you dare!

Welcome to Sunshine Bay, where you might find true love where you least expect it…!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/mrdotsgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一家知名律師事務所中躊躇滿志的初級律師，希望有一天能像交往五年的女友妮可一樣，成為出庭律師。

然而，一位青梅竹馬突然打來的電話，讓這個夢想暫時擱置。她需要你幫忙挽救經營困難的旅館，並邀請你在夏天到陽光灣工作。你們已經將近九年沒見了。這一次，兩人將有許多時間相處。不過，在陽光灣期間，你也會面對其他決定、機會、友誼與感情。同時，可別忘了深愛著你、對你一心一意的妮可。她正指望你賺些錢，償還公寓的房貸，並在夏天結束後回到她身邊！

故事中，你需要在兩個或更多選項之間作出決定。這些選擇會對你與他人的關係，以及主線劇情產生正面或負面的影響。遊戲中還會登場多位配角，只要你敢，也能與他們展開戀情！

歡迎來到陽光灣。在這裡，你或許會在最意想不到的地方，找到真愛……！
